title: Case of Yang Naiwu and Little Cabbage
text: The case of Yang Naiwu and Little Cabbage, officially the death of Zhejiang commoner Ge Pinlian (浙江民人葛品連身死案), was one of the most infamous miscarriages of justice in the Qing dynasty of China. Yang Naiwu (楊乃武), a juren who had just passed the provincial civil service examination, was falsely accused of poisoning Ge Pinlian (葛品連) to death in a conspiracy with Ge's wife nicknamed Little Cabbage in 1873. The case became a cause célèbre as both were forced to admit guilt amid continuous coverage by newspaper Shun Pao. Following multiple appeals and re-trials, the Ministry of Justice handed lenient sentences to Yang, Mrs. Ge, and witnesses accused of perjury. The ministry also fired multiple officials responsible for the unfair convictions.
